facts.value: The Mediterran Prize has been awarded annually since 2000 to outstanding theses in the fields of Classical Archaeology, Near Eastern Archaeology, or Ancient Oriental Philology to up to two graduates determined by the Foundation's Board. The prize money amounts to up to €3,000 depending on the degree and often serves as an important impetus for further career development after graduation.
